title: CREATINE
style: clean scientific still life, cool even lighting, white and steel surfaces, glass and precision instruments, shallow depth of field, minimal, high detail

music.tags: driving percussion, ostinato strings, insistent low brass, forward motion, instrumental

beats.prompt: A single scoop of fine white powder on a clean steel surface, top-down, soft studio light, one shaft of light across it
beats.motion: The powder settles slowly. Dust drifts in the light.
beats.caption: The most studied one on the shelf

line.text: Creatine is the most studied sports supplement there is.

beats.sfx: quiet room tone, a soft scoop of powder

beats.prompt: A glass of water on a steel counter with powder dissolving in it, close-up, backlit, small bubbles rising
beats.motion: The powder swirls and dissolves. Bubbles rise slowly.
beats.caption: It recycles energy for short hard efforts

line.text: Your muscles store it as phosphocreatine, and use it to recycle energy during short, hard efforts.

beats.prompt: A heavy barbell resting on a gym floor in low warm light, chalk dust in the air, close-up on the knurling
beats.motion: Chalk dust drifts slowly through the light.
beats.caption: Shows up in the last rep or two

line.text: That mostly shows up in the last rep or two of a heavy set. Small, but real, and it adds up over months.

beats.sfx: a barbell settling on a gym floor

beats.prompt: A simple glass of water beside a plain notebook on a wooden table, morning light, calm and ordinary
beats.motion: Light shifts slowly across the table.
beats.caption: Other effects are still being studied

line.text: The research also looks at effects beyond the gym, but that work is younger and less settled.

beats.prompt: An open palm holding a small amount of white powder, soft daylight, shallow focus, quiet and honest
beats.motion: The hand stays still. Light moves gently.
beats.caption: Cheap, well studied, not magic

line.text: It is cheap, it is well studied, and it is not magic.

beats.prompt: A clean empty countertop with a single glass of water, soft light, text-free minimal composition
beats.caption: Not medical advice

line.text: General information, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor about what fits you.
